correctness.rationale: The positional model is exact (upper adjacent gaps from no \(0^r\) and lower multi-step gaps from no \(1^s\)). Feasibility is closed under pointwise min/max. At a vector above a feasible target, every blocked decrement creates a dependency on another decrease: forward dependencies cross maximum r-gaps, backward dependencies stay inside blocks because a tight s-span cannot cross a gap \(r\ge3\). Acyclicity yields a legal unit decrease and hence an \(\ell^1\)-length path to the meet. The lower bound is one particle-position unit per swap, yielding exact distance. Coordinatewise median is feasible and uniquely between all pairs; complementation handles \(r=2,s\ge3\); 0101/1010 proves sharp failure at (2,2). Two distinct exhaustive checker implementations passed on their stated finite ranges; those tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: For arbitrary run bounds and length/weight, the theorem gives the exact minimum conservative reconfiguration cost with no detours, connectivity, canonical three-way median and distributive-lattice structure. Simultaneous limits on both vacancy runs and particle runs model run-length-limited coding and constrained 1D exclusion; forcing a both-two exception displays a real geometric transition rather than a trivial special case. The result is a complete natural infinite-family metric classification, not a small computed table.
